title: Heroku removing mLab MongoDB add-on.
symptom: Heroku is removing the mLab MongoDB add-on, and the user asks if there are any other free options to use.
fix: The thread suggests hosting Nightscout yourself on a Raspberry Pi or in a Docker container, or using a free Nightscout hoster at https://ns.10be.de/de/index.html. Additionally, following the email instructions to migrate to the new database is mentioned.
evidence_quote: I came across a free and friendly nightscout hoster at https://ns.10be.de/de/index.html. Consider supporting it with a donation.
